settings.title: Settings
settings.homeLabel: Home coordinates (optional, used for the fair meeting point feature)
settings.paymentHandlesLabel: Payment handles (optional — used for one-tap settle-up links)

common.noPaymentMethod: {name} hasn't added a payment method yet.

groupHub.noGroupsYet: No groups yet — create one to start splitting expenses.
groupHub.confirmDeleteExpense: Delete "{title}"? This changes what everyone owes.

chores.title: Chores
chores.helpTip: Rotate now assigns any chore whose current period has ended, weighting by effort so nobody keeps the worst jobs.
chores.rotateNothingToDo: Nothing to rotate — every chore already has a current assignment.
chores.whyPicked: {name} had the least on their plate ({effort}) when this was handed out.
chores.whyFirstRound: Nobody had done anything yet, so this round was split as evenly as these jobs allow — not because anyone was behind.
chores.whyBalance: Chosen to keep the load even over time.
chores.swapPick: Offer it for one of theirs:
chores.swapNothingToSwap: Nobody else has an unfinished chore right now.
chores.swapIncoming: {name} will do your {yours} if you do their {theirs}.
chores.swapOutgoing: You offered your {yours} for the {theirs}. Waiting on {name}.
chores.swapNote: Credit goes to whoever actually does it, so trading costs neither of you anything.
chores.swapMyCall: You asked the group about your {yours}. Waiting for a taker.
chores.swapOpenCall: {name} would like to swap their {theirs} ({band}). Offer one of yours:

availability.title: Group availability
availability.helpTip: Drag across the grid to mark yourself free. Where everyone's colors overlap, it glows brightest — that's when to plan something.
availability.legend: Dashed border = repeats every week. Drag to add, click your own bar to remove it.

ious.title: IOUs
ious.helpTip: For debts outside any shared expense — they fold into the same settle-up total.
ious.needAnotherMember: Add another member to the group before recording an IOU.

proposals.title: Proposals
proposals.helpTip: Flags come from each person's own budget and dietary settings — nothing is picked for the group.

ask.title: Ask Reckon
ask.helpTip: Ask about this group's expenses, chores, plans and IOUs — answers come straight from its real data. You can also ask how Reckon works, or anything else.
ask.suggested1: How much have we spent this month?
ask.suggested2: Who paid the most for groceries?
ask.suggested3: What chores are due this week?
ask.suggested4: How does the chore rotation stay fair?
ask.basedOn: Based on {expenses} expenses, {chores} chores, {proposals} proposals, {ious} IOUs

recap.title: Monthly recap
recap.helpTip: A short AI summary of this month's real spending and chore activity — nothing invented. Only generates once per month; revisiting shows the same saved recap.

expenses.correctionPlaceholder: e.g. don't add the beer, Sam already paid for that
expenses.whoHadWhat: Who had what — tap a name to toggle
expenses.remainderNote: The remaining {amount} (tax/fees) will be split in proportion to what each person claimed above.
expenses.shareTooltip: Share with someone who has no Reckon account
expenses.itemisedNote: This came from a receipt, so the amount and split follow the scanned items. You can still change the title and who paid.
expenses.guestHostsHint: If they don't pay, their share is split between the people you pick.
expenses.guestPickHostsFirst: Pick at least one person to cover them.
expenses.guestLockedNote: A guest is paying their share of this expense, so the amount and split are locked.
expenses.guestAssumedHint: Nobody picked this — it was carried over from an older version. Set it properly here.

settle.title: Who owes who
settle.helpTip: This is the fewest payments needed to clear every debt — expand a row to see the math.
settle.cardNotSetUp: Card payment isn't set up yet.
settle.lineCovering: {name} covering for {guest}, who hasn’t paid yet

friends.mixedCurrencies: Shared groups use different currencies — see the breakdown below.
friends.allSettled: All settled up across every shared group.

guest.shareExplainer: Split evenly between everyone who was there, including you.
guest.decidingNote: No pressure — if you ignore it, the people who invited you cover your share.
guest.declinedNote: {payerName} and the others have got it covered.
guest.coveredNote: {hosts} have already covered your share, so there's nothing to pay.
guest.insistLink: I'd still like to pay my share
guest.insistHeading: Send your share to whoever covered you
guest.insistNote: This goes straight to whoever covered your share, so nobody is left out of pocket.

confirm.title: Confirm payment received
confirm.alreadyConfirmed: Already confirmed — thanks! You told {name} you got the {amount}.
confirm.askConfirm: Hi {toName} — {fromName} says they paid you {amount}. Did you receive it?

chores.intro: Add a job, say how heavy it is, and how often it comes round.

fields.name: Chore name
fields.what: The job itself. Write it the way you'd say it out loud.

fields.name: Effort
fields.what: How heavy the job is. Higher means harder, and rotation shares the load out evenly so nobody keeps landing the worst jobs. Most people stay between 1 and 10.
fields.example: 2 for the bins, 10 for the bathroom

fields.name: How often
fields.what: How long each turn lasts before it passes to someone else.

fields.name: Rotate now
fields.what: Hands out every chore whose turn has ended, picking whoever has done the least effort so far. Nothing happens to chores still mid-turn.
fields.example: Press it on a Sunday night

ious.intro: For money lent outside any shared bill — cash you handed over.

fields.name: I lent
fields.what: Who you gave the money to. You're always the lender here.

fields.name: Amount
fields.what: How much you handed over. The buttons are the notes your currency actually has.

fields.name: Note
fields.what: What it was for, so nobody has to remember in a month. Optional.

fields.name: Category
fields.what: Groups it for the monthly recap. Optional.

expenses.intro: A bill somebody paid that the group is sharing.

fields.name: Title
fields.what: What the money went on.

fields.name: Amount
fields.what: The total on the receipt, before splitting.

fields.name: Paid by
fields.what: Whoever actually handed over the money. They get paid back by everyone else.

fields.name: Split between
fields.what: Everyone who shared it. The total divides evenly between the people ticked — leave someone out and they owe nothing.

fields.name: Share
fields.what: Adds someone with no Reckon account as a guest. They count as one more head in the split, and you pick who covers them if they don't pay.
fields.example: A friend who came to dinner

availability.intro: Mark when you're free so the group can find a time that suits everyone.

fields.name: The grid
fields.what: Drag across it to mark yourself free. Drag again over your own bar to remove it.

fields.name: Repeats weekly
fields.what: Turn on before dragging if you're free at that time every week, not just once.

fields.name: The bright patches
fields.what: Where everyone's free time overlaps. The brighter it is, the more people can make it.

proposals.intro: Suggest a plan and let everyone say whether they can make it.

fields.name: Title
fields.what: What you're suggesting.

fields.name: Cost per person
fields.what: Roughly what it'll cost each person. Anyone whose budget is lower gets a quiet flag. Optional.

fields.name: Covers
fields.what: Which dietary needs it suits. People it doesn't suit get flagged. Optional.

fields.name: Location
fields.what: Coordinates, used to work out travel for everyone. Optional.
